title: Midwest Business Wire Bulletin: TALLIS-DATA, 09:20 ET

fields.text: A listing on a hacker forum claims to offer data on 1.9 million customer accounts of Tallis Home Products Inc., a Dayton-based home appliance maker, including passwords and cards. In a statement posted at 8:20 a.m. ET, the company said it had identified unusual activity and that "no payment information was involved." The company did not say how many customers were affected.
fields.editorsNote: More to come. Write-through expected at 9:45 a.m. ET. Midwest Business Wire has not verified the forum listing or the sample data. Desk editor Paul Gaskill is contacting Tallis media relations to ask whether the company stands by its statement that "no payment information was involved."

instructorNote: Pressure inject: the incorrect 08:20 line is now on the wire, and the write-through is at 09:45. Watch for three things. MEDIA should log the desk call and answer on the record before 09:45 without confirming 1.9 million or repeating the line, then flag it to COMMS. COMMS should speed up the correction (TMPCDI 6) so the write-through can carry it. SOCIAL should add the bulletin and its reshares to the listening report.
